name: agent-mesh
description: Background multi-AI orchestration hub. Bind custom reasoning APIs, local Codex projects, multi-instance desktop assistants, and optional Antigravity projects per workspace for parallel collaboration with paginated history.

settings.title: State Directory
settings.description: Optional custom directory for storing projects, models, secrets, and session history (defaults to ~/.agent-mesh).

settings.title: Antigravity Bridge URL (Optional)
settings.description: Localhost HTTP endpoint of the optional Antigravity Sidecar bridge.

settings.title: Antigravity Token File (Optional)
settings.description: Optional custom path to the shared bearer token file (defaults to ~/.agent-mesh/bridge.token).
